about: [O6b critic] the havoc, medium hands (my own bot): E into the coupe, point it at each parked car and floor it, twice each, back off, the next; what each car shows; what lies on the road.

steps.eval: (() => { const S = G.stage.smash; const P = S.out.filter((i) => i.part); const k = {}; let live = 0; for (const it of P) { k[it.kind] = (k[it.kind]||0)+1; if (it.state==='live') live++; } return JSON.stringify({ parts: k, live, cars: G.city.cars.map((c,i)=>[i, +c.damage.toFixed(2), c.smashD&&c.smashD.state]), me:[G.controller.pos.x,G.controller.pos.z].map(v=>+v.toFixed(1)), inCar:G.city.inCar, hp:G.health.hp, t:[...document.querySelectorAll('body *')].filter(e=>e.offsetParent&&e.children.length===0&&e.innerText&&e.innerText.trim()).map(e=>e.innerText.trim().slice(0,50)).join(' | ') }); })()
